neg_vertex_fitting.desc: Observe the negative space contours and locate the truncated vertex on the grid.

neg_shape_match_2afc.desc: Memorize negative space contours and match the identical silhouette (2AFC).
neg_shape_match_2afc.instruction: Memorize the shape and select the identical one (Keys 1 / 2).
